payload.last_assistant_message:
**Summary:**

- **`io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js`** — Added `{ name: 'ctaMode', valueType: 'text', editor: 'select' }` to `SETTING_NAME_DEFINITIONS` so the setting is recognized and delivered via the pipeline
- **`studio/src/settings/setting-name-map.js`** — Added `if (definition.editor === 'select') return 'default'` branch in `getSettingDefaultValue` to prevent undefined defaults in Studio UI
- **`web-components/src/hydrate.js`** — Added `processCtaMode()` function that reads `settings.ctaMode` and suppresses the conflicting CTA type (`buy-only` removes trial CTAs, `trial-only` removes buy CTAs), with a Learn More anchor fallback when all CTAs would be removed; wired it into `hydrate()` after `processCTAs()`
- **`io/www/test/fragment/settings.test.js`** — Added 2 tests: `ctaMode` text extraction and locale override resolution
- **`web-components/test/hydrate.test.js`** — Added 9 unit tests covering `buy-only`/`trial-only` dual-CTA suppression, single-CTA fallback, `default` mode no-op, absent settings, missing footer, and empty footer

**5 files changed, 180 insertions(+)**
